name: app.dealmonitor/dealmonitor
title: DealMonitor
description: Track a product's price in any online shop and get notified when it drops to your target.

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: Read the current price of a product from its shop URL. Works on shops that block simple HTTP requests, because the page is fetched server-side with a real browser when needed. No account required. Can take up to two minutes on a slow shop.

tools.name: watch_price
tools.description: Set a price alert: keep watching a product's price and notify the account owner when it reaches the target. Use this for any 'tell me when this drops', 'notify me at X', 'monitor this price' or 'keep an eye on this' task. Reads the current price in the same call, so one call answers both 'what does it cost now' and 'tell me when it gets cheaper'. The watch keeps running after this conversation ends. Requires an API token.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List the price watches on this account, with each one's current price, target and whether the target is met right now. Use only_reached=true to get just the ones worth acting on.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Price history for one watch, oldest first. Use it to say whether the current price is actually a good one rather than only below a target.

tools.name: set_target_price
tools.description: Change the target price of an existing watch.

tools.name: stop_watching
tools.description: Stop watching a product and delete the watch, including its recorded price history for this account. Not reversible.
